answer.thought: Ramesh retreats to the kitchen, the machinery of the household grinding back to life. I remain in the study, the brown haze pressing against the glass, a thick skin over the city. The file waits for orders; I wait for the paratha. The ethical substance is not a matter of grand principles, but of a man who feeds you when the state has failed to.
